observations: Photo 0 shows two headlight assemblies with clear lenses, projector-style inner units, and black mounting brackets lying on a tiled floor.
Photo 1 shows a black front grille with vertical chrome slats and a centered Toyota emblem lying on a tiled floor.
No taillights appear in either photo; the items in photo 0 are headlights, not taillights.
Both parts show signs of use but no obvious major impact damage is visible from these angles.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a Toyota grille but no Prado model marking is visible in the photo.
Photos cannot test electrical function of bulbs, ballasts, or wiring.
Seller location cannot be confirmed from the photos.

risks.risk: Headlight bulbs, ballasts, or wiring may be non-functional
risks.proof: video of both headlights switched on

risks.risk: Grille mounting tabs or clips may be broken or missing
risks.proof: close-up photos of all rear mounting points on the grille

risks.risk: Parts may not fit a Prado (wrong model or year)
risks.proof: photo of part number label or OEM stamp on the rear of the grille and headlights

risks.risk: Lenses may have cracks, haze, or internal moisture not visible in these shots
risks.proof: macro close-up of each headlight lens surface

proof_requests: Video of both headlights turned on
Close-up photos of the rear mounting tabs and clips on the grille
Photo of any part number or OEM label on the back of the grille and headlights
Macro photos of the headlight lenses to check for cracks or haze
response.reason: The items are identifiable as a used Toyota front grille and a pair of headlights; the seller's taillight claim is contradicted by the photos, and working condition is unproven, so both are priced at their worst case as non-working used parts.
